usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and Notion records each one as an item through “Create_Data_Source_Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create_Data_Source_Item” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Each new task becomes an item in your Notion data source, so planning lives in one place.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so the Notion item appears after a scheduled check, not at once.
